footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to LXP Industrial: after $4.5M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $6.7M of preferred dividends, $4.9M of other items, net. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 2.3% to $350M in 2025. Gross margin was 81.6%, versus 83.1% a year earlier, and operating income rose 86.0% to $195M, a 55.6% margin.
Net income rose 2.8× to $106M, or $1.82 per share. Operating cash flow was $189M and free cash flow $164M, versus $193M; LXP Industrial returned $168M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: LXP Industrial Trust Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
